static_traits.name: 周薇
static_traits.social_status: 有朋友和家人可倾诉，但尚not yet与他人讨论此问题；与冲浪搭档关系因自身的负面解释而变得紧张
static_traits.medical_history: not yet有类似问题经历；既往not yet接受心理治疗；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、能具体描述时间和事件；情绪基调偏消极；存在“读心术”“跳结论”的认知倾向；与咨询师配合度较好，愿意尝试行为实验；Self-monitoring与自我苛责明显

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得我的冲浪搭档not再和我一起冲浪，是因为他们认为我冲浪not够好，这让我很痛苦并产生自我not足感。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些自我not足感和Self-doubt正在影响我对冲浪的享受，我因此决定寻求咨询。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough（能力not足）
我的价值取决于他人对我能力的看法

special_situations.event: About a month ago, the surfing partner stopped surfing with me
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人not愿与我一起冲浪，就说明我技术not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 主动与搭档沟通以获得解释与安慰
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们停止和我一起就是因为I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Surfing alone in the sea; negative thoughts arise every time surfing alone
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not人愿意和我一起冲浪，说明我让人尴尬、not人愿意接近我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与他人谈论此事以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我一定让人尴尬去一起冲浪

special_situations.event: 上周末在浪上摔落（wipe out），当时周围并have not人看到
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在浪上失误，就证明我整体水平not合格
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 事后Reinforcement自我批评，试图通过自责来“改进”表现
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这就是他们not想和我一起的原因，I am not good enough

special_situations.event: 搭档解释not同行是因为日程忙碌而非我的技术问题
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他人的解释与我的担忧相矛盾，那只是礼貌性的借口，not能说明问题
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 坚持use私下推测他人想法而非搜集更多证据
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是找借口，not好意思说我not行

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and recognized, especially hoping to be seen as competent by peers in an important activity (surfing)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected与被评判为not够好，担心暴露not足后遭到贬低
defense_goal: 通过先行Self-denial与谨慎推测他人评价来减少被直接negate的风险

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、容易Being rejected的个体
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔且可能negate自己的他者（如搭档）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests more directly verifying the reason with the partner and designing a behavioral experiment
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者担心这样会让关系更糟、对方会证实自己“not够好”（将他人潜在反馈视为威胁）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以犹豫、担心的语气表达顾虑，use“如果/可能/会not会”等词，回避立即承诺并请求脚本或准备问题以获得掌控感。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes the lack of evidence and encourages examining facts (such as the partner truly being busy)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者将自身“not被接纳”的感受归因于他人对自己的负面看法（认为对方只是找借口）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 强调“他们只是礼貌说忙”，坚持自己的解释，语气坚定但带not安，减少在事实证据上的深入讨论。

manifestations: 搭档not再同行带来的被拒体验
独自下海冲浪时感到Loneliness与Self-doubt
将技术失误（摔落）与被他人negate联系在一起
outcomes: 对冲浪的享受显著下降

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 认为搭档看not起自己、只是找借口not与自己冲浪
把内心的not被接纳感解释为他人的真实想法

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在海上反复自我苛责与Self-denial
Worries that communicating with a partner will 'mess things up', hopes for scripts and question lists to reduce risk

exception_events.target_problem: 在搭档缺席的情况下，来访者通常会进行读心式臆测并Self-doubt，导致冲浪体验下降与Relationship tension
exception_events.unique_outcome: 曾主动与搭档沟通此事，得到对方说明是因行程忙碌、并非对其技术negate；获得了与自身假设not同的信息
exception_events.reason: not同做法：主动沟通核实原因；not同支持：对方明确给出现实解释（忙碌安排）

positive_force: 愿意求助并接受咨询，配合度较好
Willing to try behavioral experiments and script preparation, has action willingness
能够识do not自身负性自动思维（如“也许I am not good enough”）
存在一定社会支持（朋友与家人）
negative_force: 读心术与跳结论倾向显著
negate正面信息，Reinforcement自我not足的信念
Excessive reliance on external evaluation to define self-worth
Self-monitoring与自我苛责导致体验收缩、避免直接接触

target_behavior.behavior: 在冲浪时反复进行自我贬低与读心式臆测（如“I am not good enough、他们not想和我一起”），伴随Loneliness与Self-doubt
antecedent: 一个月前搭档停止同行
回想搭档表示忙碌的解释
target_behavior.core_reason: 对Being rejected高度敏感与“读心术/跳结论”的认知偏差，且过度依赖他人评价来界定能力与自我价值
target_behavior.function: Self-protection与逃避not确定性：通过先行Self-denial来避免面对可能的拒绝与尴尬
target_behavior.consequence: 冲浪乐趣下降、Increased sense of loneliness、与搭档Relationship tension、Persistent self-doubt
